data.title: Exagamglogene Autotemcel for Severe Sickle Cell Disease
data.abstract: In this open-label phase 3 study, a single infusion of exagamglogene autotemcel (exa-cel) eliminated severe vaso-occlusive crises in 29 of 30 patients with sickle cell disease over a follow-up of up to 24 months.

data.title: CRISPR-Cas9 Gene Editing for Sickle Cell Disease and Transfusion-Dependent Thalassemia
data.abstract: Two patients with transfusion-dependent beta-thalassemia and sickle cell disease were treated with CTX001, an autologous CRISPR-Cas9-edited CD34+ cell product, producing sustained increases in fetal hemoglobin.
